edits.old: Then every rule ID, condition, timer and message text comes from a governed row with a version and none is written in code
edits.new:
Then every rule ID, condition, timer and message text comes from a governed row with a version and none is written in code

  Scenario: AC10 An error answers 401, 403 or 404 of the provided operations (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given claim "GCL-SYN-0414" of case "RW-2026-000914" is in state PREPARING
    When a request to the provided operations has no valid credentials, lacks the right or names an unknown claim
    Then the operation answers 401 when the credentials are missing, 403 when the right is missing and 404 when the claim is unknown, and nothing changes

  Scenario: AC11 A replay of a write with the same idempotency key writes no second filing (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given claim "GCL-SYN-0414" is in state CLAIM_APPROVAL
    When the write is replayed with the same idempotency key
    Then no second filing is written and the claim row is unchanged

  Scenario: AC12 A duplicate delivery of a consumed event writes no second filing (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the inbox has consumed the cloud event with its cloud event id
    When the same event is delivered again
    Then the inbox dedupes the event and no second filing is written

  Scenario: AC13 A retried or timed-out activity leaves the step where it was (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the account view does not answer
    When the activity is retried and the attempts are exhausted
    Then the step stays where it was and the officer sees MSG-GEN-006 naming the product

  Scenario: AC14 A status change the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given claim "GCL-SYN-0414" is in state PREPARING
    When the step asks to move the claim to CLAIM_SUBMITTED
    Then the change is refused and nothing changes
